<issue>
Token.is_child_of method missing after recent changes

#### Description

The `is_child_of` method on Token objects is no longer available, causing AttributeError when trying to check parent-child relationships between tokens.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import sqlparse

s = '(col1, col2)'
p = sqlparse.parse(s)[0]
p.tokens[0].tokens[1].is_child_of(p.tokens[0])
```

This raises:
```
AttributeError: 'Identifier' object has no attribute 'is_child_of'
```

Expected behavior: Should return `True` since the token is a direct child of the parent token.

The method was previously available and allowed checking if a token is a direct child of another token by comparing `self.parent == other`.
</issue>
